ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/grey) to 30% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity contiguous white patches concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes; dense distribution of small white focal spots (mottling) throughout the central and medial low-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 110 degrees and a depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous boundary; multiple distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 4 to 15 pixels in amplitude relative to the local mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily convex trajectory on the proximal trailing edge, tapering with a slight concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters scattered across the dark central and lower regions of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several visible vertical and diagonal white linear streaks (rake-like marks) crossing the dark pigmentation on the medial portions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation/notch on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; significant jagged irregularity on the trailing edge of the left lobe distal to the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Complex circular/loop pigmentation pattern localized within the high-intensity white patch on the distal tip of the left fluke lobe.
